Xiao Lin is very afraid of the dark, and everyone knows that he needs to keep a nightlight on every night when sleeping. However, when his friend comes to stay overnight at his house, Xiao Lin turns off the nightlight.

[Question]
Why does Xiao Lin turn off the night light when his friend comes over?
